Automating guest follow-up and arrival instructions

Two systems that freed time for more productive work.

The objective

At a vacation-rental hospitality business, Raju’s team was struggling to keep up with following up with potential guests, and arrival instructions had to reach every guest.

Raju’s contribution

Raju personally designed and implemented two systems:

  • An automated follow-up system for potential guests.
  • An automated arrival-instruction workflow. An automated agent checks twice a day for guests whose identity confirmation has come in and been verified, and sends those guests their arrival instructions.

The outcome

  • Guest follow-up: by Raju’s estimate, at least 12 hours a week freed for more productive work.
  • Arrival instructions: by Raju’s estimate, three to six hours a week saved.

These are separate estimates for the two systems.

Source: Raju Lalwani’s account.

The experience this brings

Spotting repetitive customer-service work and designing practical automation that frees people for higher-value tasks.
